body.summary: The testimony discusses a conversation between Director Casey, General Secord, and Admiral Poindexter regarding security clearances for General Secord. There was a suggestion that General Secord return to the government to 'clean up' his reputation problem from an earlier tenure. A prop message (Exhibit 161) mentions that CIA could not produce an aircraft on short notice, so General Secord chartered one through a company called Project Democracy Overseas. The testimony suggests that General Secord's Swiss accounts were low on funds at the time, which explains why he was surprised to learn of $8 million remaining in his accounts. There is discussion about the allocation of funds for different purposes within 'Project Democracy'. A prop note (Exhibit 159) from Admiral Poindexter mentions keeping pressure on Bill Casey to make things right for General Secord.
